certificates.type:
∀ (A : Type u) (R : A → A → Type v)
  (h : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.reflexiveNative.{u, v} A R),
  Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
    (Computational.CRelation.Rocq.Corelib.Classes.CRelationClasses.flip_Reflexive.{u, v, w} A R h)
    (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.CRelation.flipReflexive.{u, v} A R h)

∀ (A : Type u) (E : A → A → Type v)
  (equ : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.equivalenceNative.{u, v} A E)
  (R : A → A → Type w)
  (h : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.antisymmetricNative.{u, v, w} A E R),
  Eq.{max (max (u + 1) (v + 1)) (w + 1)}
    (Computational.CRelation.Rocq.Corelib.Classes.CRelationClasses.flip_Antisymmetric.{u, w, v, t} A E
      (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Iso.of.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
        (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.EquivalenceIso.{u, v} A E) equ)
      R h)
    (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.CRelation.flipAntisymmetric.{u, v, w} A E R h)

∀ (A : Type u) (E R : A → A → Type v)
  (equ : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.equivalenceNative.{u, v} A E)
  (pre : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.preorderNative.{u, v} A R)
  (h : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationOrder.partialOrderNative.{u, v} A E R),
  Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
    (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationOrder.partialTo.{u, v} A E (fun x y => R y x)
      (Computational.CRelation.Rocq.Corelib.Classes.CRelationClasses.PartialOrder_inverse.{u, w, t, z, v} A E
        (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Iso.of.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
          (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.EquivalenceIso.{u, v} A E) equ)
        R
        (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Iso.of.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
          (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.PreOrderIso.{u, v} A R) pre)
        (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationOrder.partialOf.{u, v} A E R h)))
    (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.CRelation.inversePartialOrder.{u, v} A E R h)

∀ (A : Type u) (E R : A → A → Type v)
  (equ : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.equivalenceNative.{u, v} A E)
  (pre : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.preorderNative.{u, v} A R)
  (h : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationOrder.partialOrderNative.{u, v} A E R),
  Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
    (Computational.CRelation.Rocq.Corelib.Classes.CRelationClasses.partial_order_antisym.{u, w, t, z, v} A E
      (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Iso.of.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
        (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.EquivalenceIso.{u, v} A E) equ)
      R
      (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Iso.of.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
        (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.PreOrderIso.{u, v} A R) pre)
      (Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationOrder.partialOf.{u, v} A E R h))
    (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.CRelation.partialAntisymmetry.{u, v} A E R h)

∀ (A : Type u) (R : A → A → Type v)
  (h : Computational.CRelation.NativeBridge.Incremental.CRelationData.symmetricNative.{u, v} A R),
  Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
    (Computational.CRelation.Rocq.Corelib.Classes.CRelationClasses.subrelation_symmetric.{u, w, v} A R h)
